topic: Is the Snowdon Ranger path up Snowdon open, and how long does it take?

text: Morning all 🙂 been looking at snowdon for the spring trip. Is the snowdon ranger path actually open right now and how long does it take? @claude

Morning Marco. I couldn't find a current closure notice for the Snowdon Ranger path, but I also couldn't confirm it's open today. The guides I found were general and not dated. Before you go, check the Eryri National Park Authority site and the mountain weather forecast. It's late November now, so conditions can be wintry. By spring it should be a different story.

I didn't open a page with a time for it, so this is from memory. Most guides put it at about 3 to 4 hours up and 2 to 3 hours down, roughly 8 miles return, starting from the Ranger car park on the A4085. It's the quieter side of the mountain. The summit cafe is shut out of season, so take your own food.

Sources: Snowdon Info (snowdoninfo.com), Walk Snowdonia (walksnowdonia.co.uk), Trailforks, and The Bald Scrambler.

text: @claude how long is the llanberis path to the summit and is it busier than the ranger one? Also is there a train from cardiff or london to llanberis or do we need a car 🙏

The Llanberis path is about 9 miles return, or 4.5 miles each way. Allow roughly 2.5 to 4 hours up, and 5 to 7 hours for the round trip. The park authority lists a shorter distance, 6.8 miles, so the sources disagree a bit. It's the longest and gentlest route, and it's also the busiest, so the Ranger path will be quieter.

You don't need a car. There's no train to Llanberis itself, and the nearest mainline station is Bangor, about 10 miles away. From London there are direct trains to Bangor, around 3h 20m. From Cardiff you'd change trains and it takes about 4 to 5.5 hours, depending on the source. From Bangor, the Sherpa S2 bus gets you to Llanberis in about 50 minutes.

I haven't checked live timetables. Sherpa times change by season, so look at the Eryri site before booking anything for March or April.

Sources: [Snowdon Info](https://snowdoninfo.com/llanberis-path/), [SummitPost](https://www.summitpost.org/route/299010/Llanberis-Path.html), [Walk Up Snowdon](https://www.walkupsnowdon.co.uk/getting-to-snowdon-snowdonia-from-london-elsewhere/), [Rome2rio](https://www.rome2rio.com/s/London/Llanberis), [Eryri National Park](https://eryri.gov.wales/?p=17558)

Phone a local firm like Bangor Cabs or Taxi Arfon for a fixed price, and book ahead if you land late.
